title: Chapter 345 Da Huang, Come Out
content:
Chapter 345 Da Huang, Come Out

Kotaro didn't even have the strength to fight back.

He was entangled in chains, and the more he struggled, the faster he sank.

"Brother, wait a minute, let's talk it over!"

Wang Shuo summoned the mud puppet again. In the swamp, the mud puppet did not seem bulky, but was like a fish in water.

Wang Shuo thought, if only he could move freely in the swamp like the mud puppet.

The current cloud-stepping boots can't do that.

It seems that he needs a better pair of boots, or a light-body technique.

Wang Shuo stood in the distance and continued to attack from a distance.

Although Kotaro kept begging for mercy, Wang Shuo was unmoved.

A few minutes later, Kotaro was killed.

Wang Shuo asked the mud puppet to drag him out and confiscated the Shura Order on him.

A total of five pieces were obtained.

In this way, Wang Shuo had eight pieces.

A good start, Wang Shuo was very satisfied.

Wang Shuo discovered the power of the skill "Abyssal Swamp", so he kept practicing the skill in this area.

Two hours later, Wang Shuo created a large swamp and upgraded the silt puppet skill to level 3.

At this time, it was impossible to view the data. Wang Shuo estimated that the health of this puppet should be nearly 10,000.

During this period, Wang Shuo tried to summon the three-headed hellhound and found that Da Huang could still be summoned, but other hellhounds could not be summoned.

Wang Shuo also thought that if he summoned 1,000 hellhounds, he could sweep the entire first floor.

Unfortunately, he was not able to exploit this loophole.

Wang Shuo made some wall bricks.

The durability of wall bricks that have not been fired in a brick kiln will be reduced by half.

But at this time, he could only make do with it.

Wang Shuo built a small house on the hard ground in the middle of the swamp and rested for a night.

With Da Huang guarding the night, the night was peaceful.

The next morning, Wang Shuo was a little hungry.

Thinking of the three scheming people yesterday, Wang Shuo did not eat the food found on them.

Wang Shuo now has two choices, one is to go hunting or find some fruits in the forest.

But obviously, there will be risks.

The second is to let Da Huang bring a prey to him from the breeding space.

In the breeding space, a large number of small animals are raised for the hellhounds to eat.

Wang Shuo is still a little worried about whether Da Huang can succeed.

Not long after, Da Huang came out with a goat.

This made Wang Shuo very happy.

He touched the heads of the three dogs, and then started to make a fire to roast the goat.

Although the air here is already humid, Wang Shuo, as a senior general, his hand speed is definitely not comparable to that of his younger brothers who have been single for 20 years.

After a while, he succeeded in making a fire.

When the lamb was roasted on the rack, Wang Shuo sighed in his heart. When he was in the crocodile territory, his hands were rubbed with blisters, but there was no spark.

He is now quite satisfied with his hand speed.

Eating the roasted lamb, Wang Shuo began to think about the next path.

We still have to go to Yingying Town to take a look.

At the same time, we have to kill more competitors and obtain the Shura Order.

After thinking for a while, Wang Shuo felt that if he had been hiding here, no enemies would come close at all. It seems that he still has to take the initiative to attack.

After eating, he began to patrol the area.

The edge of the swamp is still a dense forest.

Wang Shuo doesn't know how to make any hunting traps. A crudely made trap will only make the enemy notice it, which will have the opposite effect.

At this time, Da Huang barked.

"Stupid dog, don't bark."

Wang Shuo was afraid of exposing himself.

However, a beast roar came from a distance.

Wang Shuo didn't find any large beasts all day yesterday. He thought there were only people here, but no beasts!

"Let's go and take a look."
